competences.description: Attacks with a spinning punch and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 50% chance and recovers HP by 20% of inflicted damage.

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Launches 2 consecutive attacks on an enemy, inflicting damage and decreasing the enemy's Attack Bar by 25% with each attack.

When you are attacked with a Critical Hit, increases your Attack Bar by 40% and counterattacks the attacker with 100% Critical Rate. You won't get defeated with Critical Hit attacks. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
